subject: Life Skills

source.subtopic: Different types of homes and what homes are made of; a home provides shelter and safety

show.line: People live in houses, flats, huts and shacks. A home keeps us safe and dry!

rounds.prompt: Tap the tall building with many homes. It is a flat.
rounds.praise: Flats! Many homes in one building.

rounds.prompt: Which home has a round wall and a grass roof?
What is this house made of?
Why do we need a home?
Strong material for a house, or not? Sort them.
What kind of home do you live in?

hints: Homes can be big or small, but all keep us safe.
A strong home keeps out wind and rain.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will build a home.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: I will build it from paper!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Paper is not strong. Bricks are strong.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's build with bricks. Strong and safe!

parent_line: Can name types of homes and why people need them.
